title: Back in Control
summary:
OPEC+ seems to have regained its grip on the oil markets
In early 2020, the OPEC+ group was in disarray. Saudi Arabia and Russia, the leading producers of the oil exporters organization, disagreed on how to respond to the Covid-19 pandemic, which was then rapidly spreading across the globe. A brief price war broke out, which proved to be very costly for the OPEC members, and a boon for the tanker market.
